assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE compact Cyberpunk RED 2045 game catalogue section icon for dndShare. Original polished graphic 2D CEL SHADING. Thick continuous deep-plum outer outline, sparse confident thinner inner lines, broad clean color planes, restrained two-step shadow and one broad upper-left highlight, matte materials, almost no texture. Must read at 64 pixels. Complete subject centered in square, occupies 82–86%, even transparent margins. GENUINE transparent alpha; no background, checkerboard, enclosing tile, disc, frame, ground shadow, glow halo, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Subject: One compact amber translucent control-core cabinet with a central dark processor and three short teal cable connectors, representing a NET daemon controlling devices. Engineered object, no devil or magical creature.
